nodes.statement:
Assume that $\mathcal{T}\in \mathbb{R}_{ps,+}^{n^{\times d}}$.


Assume that $\Psi:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$ is a convex function.  

Suppose furthermore that $\Psi'(\log \rho(\mathcal{T}))\geqslant 0$.  Then
 \[\Psi(\log\rho(\mathcal{T}))=\max_{(p_1,\ldots,p_n)^\top\in \Pi_n}\inf_{\mathbf{x}>\mathbf{0}}\sum_{i=1}^n p_i  \Psi(\log\frac{(\mathcal{T}\mathbf{x})_i}{x_i^{d-1}}).\]
 In particular
 \begin{equation}
 \rho(\mathcal{T})=\max_{(p_1,\ldots,p_n)^\top\in \Pi_n}\inf_{\mathbf{x}>\mathbf{0}}\sum_{i=1}^n p_i  \frac{(\mathcal{T}\mathbf{x})_i}{x_i^{d-1}}.
 \end{equation}
